scope: Offline token-weighted citation-form targets and opt-in running-text length/ syllable configuration experiment; no claim about connected speech, syntax or human preference.

frequencySource.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; attribution Brysbaert, New and Keuleers; derived research artifacts retain this license and are separate from code/default runtime data

selection.frequencyPopulation: 74286 ASCII word-form types, unique after lowercase
selection.pronunciation: cmu-ascii-first-v1; first unlabelled compatible citation pronunciation; no frequency split over variants
selection.join: exact lowercase spelling; unmatched types and token mass remain explicit before any normalization
selection.rawStringPopulation: 282170 rows / 51010983 counts; diagnostic only, not pooled into word-form target

split.algorithm: unsigned first 32 big-endian bits of SHA256(JSON.stringify([seed, spelling])) modulo 10000
split.unit: normalized lexical spelling; lexical-type holdout, not subtitle-document holdout; morphology families not grouped

tables: syllable-count conditional on word phoneme count; syllable count equals explicit CMU vowels
models.smoothing: (row count + alpha * common normalized base)/(row total + alpha); phone uniform over fixed 69 ARPABET symbols; length geometric P(n)=2^-n for positive integer n; syllable-count uniform 1..phoneme-count
models.developmentSelection: Each arm independently minimizes full FREQcount-weighted mean per-word [negative log joint length/syllable probability + mean negative log phone probability]; ties choose smaller alpha; retain every trial
models.heldOut: Construct and score only after both development choices are fixed; every word and all declared strata retained
models.targets: Export unrounded integer training count tables and smoothed distributions; do not fit on full or held-out corpus

functionWordPolicy.fullTarget: Every joined type with FREQcount, including names/function words
functionWordPolicy.allocation: Secondary modeled allocation: FREQcount times within-row tag-count share; exact rational masses. Not observed token partition. Missing/noninteger/zero-tag rows enter unknown allocation. Retain all raw POS/FREQ discrepancies; do not choose dominant POS or suppress names.

runtime.policy: Explicit opt-in adapter sets text phoneme-length and phoneme-to-syllable targets from frozen candidate training joint counts; baseline config unchanged; lexicon weights unchanged
runtime.support: Existing positive-integer phoneme lengths 1..20 and configured syllable range; explicitly report unsupported target mass before conditioning; reject zero eligible mass; no silently truncated targets
runtime.phoneTargets: Report source and generated phone distances; this length/syllable experiment does not directly overwrite phoneme inventories or phonotactic weights
runtime.trace: Public APIs only; common full trace diagnostics and RNG trace/plain parity

generatorMeasurement.performance: six adjacent control/candidate pairs using existing benchmark warmups, seeds, trials, sample counts, speed floors and variance thresholds; retain every outcome

reporting: source and installed execution pins before/after
held-out word and phone denominators separately; every stratum, including missing POS, names, rare types and frequent function words
no human preference inference without real independently collected responses
